result.quote: but Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him. And many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate.
result.reason: The window supports that Gaal flees and that many Shechemites are wounded, but it does not say that many die. The broad wording also permits other defensible details, such as Abimelech pursuing Gaal. A precise answer would be: “Abimelech pursues Gaal; Gaal flees, and many Shechemites are wounded.”
